location_description: Forest Hills is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP) in Kent County in the U.S. state of Michigan.   The population was 25,867 at the 2010 census.Forest Hills is the most-populated CDP and also the largest by area in the state of Michigan.  The CDP encompasses nearly all of Ada Township and most of the northern half of Cascade Township.
